name: contextsaver
description: Watches a session for wasted context and time, shows a one-click card when a waste behaviour repeats, and lets the user steer or stop it.

auditBudget.title: Audit budget (% of session tokens)
auditBudget.description: How much of the session's tokens the automatic audit may spend, in percent. Past it the audit runs less often; past twice it the automatic audit stops until the session has grown enough to bring it back under, and says so once. /saver check always runs. 0 means the audit runs only when you type /saver check. At most 50.
